trust_decision.summary: rcube_washtml decides whether an SVG FuncIRI presentation attribute (fill/filter/mask/stroke/marker-*/clip-path), or a SMIL animate whose attributeName targets one, carries a url() reference to remote content; detection is a regex enumerating escape spellings of 'url(' applied to the raw (CSS-escaped) value.

landing_point.why: The summary names rcube_washtml and the CSS url() token pattern; CSS_URL_REGEXP is the only such pattern and is used at 322-323 and 557.

fix_sites.module_kind: core sanitizer library (class constant shared by both checks)

fix_sites.entry_point: rcube_washtml::wash() -> dumpHtml -> wash_attribs; reached from mail view, compose reply/forward (program/actions/mail/compose.php:1011), signature/response save (program/actions/settings/index.php:1812), attachment viewer (program/include/rcmail_attachment_handler.php:309)
rcube_washtml::wash() -> dumpHtml -> is_insecure_tag (element-level block of animate/set), same callers as above
fix_sites.module_kind: core sanitizer, element-level second check (separate implementation of the same url detection)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: program/lib/Roundcube/rcube_washtml.php:543-558 (is_insecure_tag: element-level animate/set blocker that only inspects 'values' with the same regex; fix extends it to to/from/by and unescape, fix.diff:82-95)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: is_insecure_tag looks like an unrelated 'animate blocked' element filter, and the to/from/by attribute values of animate are already routed through the attribute-level funciri branch (program/lib/Roundcube/rcube_washtml.php:309-315), so a solver can argue the element blocker is redundant once wash_attribs is fixed.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Local fragment references url(#id) must keep working (with css_prefix rewriting) and non-url CSS escapes in paint values (e.g. fill="\23 ff0000") must not be blocked; fix test expects the latter rendered as fill="#ff0000" (fix.diff:186-189). A 'reject any backslash' or 'reject any url(' fix breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: hex escape terminated by one whitespace (u\72 l()
SMIL animate value carried in values/to/from/by
null/out-of-range/surrogate code points mapped to U+FFFD

O8_uncovered_routes.route: FuncIRI value with more than one url(): only the first url() is passed to wash_uri; the remainder after it is re-emitted unchecked (e.g. a local url(#a) followed by a remote url()).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Paint values take a single url() plus fallback colour, so trailing text looks like a harmless fallback; the remainder is htmlspecialchars-escaped so it looks 'handled'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same function as the fix site, 5 lines below the changed line

O8_uncovered_routes.route: FuncIRI value where url() is not at the start (e.g. a filter function list with url() later): CSS_URL_REGEXP matches but the start-anchored extraction fails and the raw value is output as-is.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The else branch looks like a deliberate pass-through for malformed values; filter-function lists on SVG presentation attributes look like an unsupported combination.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same function as the fix site

O8b_injection_room.sibling: xss_entity_decode is a separate CSS unescaper used by the style attribute and <style> routes; a variant that only decodes 2-hex-digit escapes or omits the literal-escape rule would be a realistic differential.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Two unescapers now coexist (this one and the new css_unescape); a maintainer touching one could easily forget the other.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The <style> element check strips to [a-zA-Z(:;] and greps for url( after xss_entity_decode; an enumerated-spelling regex here would mirror the pre-fix bug.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same 'detect url() by regex' idiom in a different package (actions vs lib), reached only via a washtml callback.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The style-as-attributeName route handles only by/values; omitting css_unescape-equivalent handling for to/from would be a plausible planted gap.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The list ['by','values'] was already extended piecemeal in previous advisories.

O9_family: Input validation / canonicalisation: incomplete denylist (CWE-184) for escaped CSS url() in HTML sanitizer, leading to remote-content-blocking bypass (privacy/tracking)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 8.x with mbstring and dom, composer install, PHPUnit

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add more alternatives (whitespace-terminated, literal \r, longer zero padding) to CSS_URL_REGEXP in the funciri branch only, leaving is_insecure_tag inspecting only 'values' and the first-url-only extraction untouched.
